card.line: Abarim is a mountain range east of the Jordan in Moab, facing Jericho, where Moses was told to view the Promised Land before he died.

moments.title: Israel camps in the Abarim mountains
moments.text: The Israelites set out and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo. Then they moved on to the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

moments.title: Moses told to see the land
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to go up the Abarim range and see the land given to the Israelites. Moses would then be gathered to his people, as Aaron was. Moses asked the LORD to appoint a leader, and the LORD pointed to Joshua.

moments.title: Moses told to climb Mount Nebo
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo and view Canaan. He would see the land from a distance and die there, but he would not enter it.
